contractFacts.A04: Each primary title_alignment_score>=90; exact evidence and reproducible rubric; arbitrary author self-score insufficient.
contractFacts.Blueprint10: Each public candidate SEO>=90/GEO>=85/AEO>=90 plus source/truth/collision/inbound/parent/technical gates. Numeric weighting formula is not supplied by the retained contracts.
contractFacts.v12_17: All named content, CTA, image and architecture/HTML/sitemap gates remain mandatory. A score cannot offset one.

content.scoring: Only directly inspected evidence earns full criterion weight; FAIL earns0; untested REQUIRED earns0 verified points and remains PENDING. Never rebase denominator to tested-only criteria or pass by averaging pages. Verified points are review coverage under this disclosed internal rubric, not Google/Naver/LLM performance.

rubricDefinition.provenance: Only fixed-100 SEO, GEO and AEO criterion definitions, weights and thresholds are reused. Every Namgu score is newly evaluated here. No previous region’s evidence, scores or replacement 18-clause manuscript assessment are copied. The original Namgu 149 guidance rows, 13 policy clauses and null scores remain immutable.

criteria.criterion: Within180 codepoints first answer states actual relevant offer and buyer step; core answer begins within120.
criteria.reason: Each complete first answer is within 180 code points and the core offer begins within 120. Home covers budget and ribbon consultation and directs photos to detail; detail introduces four products, basic prices and consultation.

criteria.criterion: Role-specific questions answered: home discovery/price/contact, detail venue/product/price/ribbon/order/change/collection; no word-count filler.
criteria.reason: Home answers budget, ribbon and discovery needs. Detail covers facility identity, products, prices, ribbons, ordering, changes and collection. Three specific FAQs appear without word-count padding.

criteria.criterion: Answer facts and conditional policies have primary evidence without overclaiming.
criteria.reason: Material answer claims trace to primary evidence. Unknown fees, current operation, timing and order-specific policy application remain uncertain rather than being filled with unsupported claims.

criteria.criterion: Main HTML contains complete answers with sensible headings, and each specified FAQ appears once; home has no quota FAQ requirement.
criteria.reason: Answers appear in the complete main HTML with logical headings. Three question-answer pairs occur exactly once and are expanded. Home does not add an artificial FAQ quota.

criteria.criterion: Actionable next step uses exact seller phone or SKU destination and helpful provider tone.
criteria.reason: The exact merchant phone and four SKU destinations provide a clear next step. No completed external order or phone call is inferred.

criteria.criterion: Actual browser computed visibility/readability confirms static answer/FAQ/CTA extraction.
criteria.reason: Original first-answer, FAQ and CTA pixels, 15 DOM snapshots and bound computed-visibility observations agree across three widths. Full-page and cross-width originals jointly cover content obscured in some element crops.

criteria.criterion: Provider, venue and service entities unambiguous; provider contact distinguished from facility contacts.
criteria.reason: The seller 꽃이랑 at 1844-0644 and facility 광주남문장례식장(주) at 062-675-5000 are distinct. No facility ownership, affiliation or operator-domain continuity is asserted.

criteria.criterion: Every material venue/catalog/policy assertion traced to inspected primary-source content; original dates and source level retained.
criteria.reason: The 2026-04-01 facility CSV, four catalog originals and two policy images support the factual copy. The source section distinguishes the 2026-10-16 KST product check from the facility baseline. Current operation is not inferred.

criteria.criterion: Useful local/order content, not place-name substitution or decorative local history.
criteria.reason: The facility identifier, unknown Namgu shipping amount, photo comparison, total-budget, ribbon and ordering questions provide useful local context. One facility cluster is retained. The bounded comparison does not certify nationwide originality or doorway-policy compliance.

criteria.criterion: Conditions and uncertainty explicit; prices not total, sample not exact fulfillment, no fake delivery/refund/affiliation proof.
criteria.reason: Basic and total prices are distinct, and photos are labeled as samples. Material mix, no-collection and refund limitations remain explicit. Manufacture-completed and post-dispatch conditions are retained separately; exact delivery and entry are not promised.

criteria.criterion: Readable semantic source/answer sections and meaningful, non-conflicting page roles; no invented review/schema evidence.
criteria.reason: Semantic answer and source sections and complementary home, detail, support and 404 roles have meaningful hierarchy. No fabricated testimonials or structured review data were found.

criteria.criterion: One defined primary query/intent and traceable query evidence; missing keyword metadata explicitly supplemented and hash-bound in this review.
criteria.reason: Original Namgu purchase-intent metadata supplies the exact primary query, related queries, distinct intent key and bound search/competitor observations. Search observations remain retained tool reports, never measured volume or ranking.

criteria.criterion: A04 static title/H1/firstAnswer >=90 and no hard alignment failure.
criteria.reason: This new artifact assessment applies the five original Namgu qualitative alignment criteria with disclosed equal weights of 20 points. Each primary page earns 100/100. Original null historical scores remain unchanged.

criteria.criterion: Unique title/meta, one H1, coherent H2/H3; actual used summary passes separation rules.
criteria.reason: All four titles and descriptions are unique, each page has one H1, and H2/H3 hierarchy is coherent. Home and support card summaries differ from the title, H1 and first answer. All 112 strings retain exact r2 copy.

criteria.criterion: Actual local/vertical facts and supported catalog; no invented claim.
criteria.reason: The dated MOHW facility name, address and phone, four merchant catalogs and original policy images were rechecked. Current operation, entry and delivery costs remain conditional.

criteria.criterion: Real internal targets/inbound/breadcrumb and distinct home/detail buyer decisions.
criteria.reason: Home, detail and support have functioning bounded internal targets and inbound links. The regional budget entry differs from the facility photo and ordering decision. No hub was fabricated.

criteria.criterion: Provider-led full-copy information and real HTML phone/SKU action links, not image-only actions.
criteria.reason: Complete customer text appears in the actual HTML. Exact phone and SKU anchors accompany useful photo, budget, ribbon and ordering copy. Seller-led prose uses a restrained condolence tone and brief natural empathy.

criteria.criterion: Local assets exist; descriptive alt/sample labeling; exact approved banner exception.
criteria.reason: Four official 500×500 photos and three approved 1774×887 banners match their bound bytes. Descriptive alt text, dimensions, sample labeling and banner separation were checked across seven files and 30 rendered occurrences.

criteria.criterion: Production canonical/robots/OG/Twitter/sitemap/map agree for approved origin.
criteria.reason: The 18 sealed release files, 15 DOM snapshots and actual metadata agree on intended-host canonical, robots, social and sitemap values. Public-host deployment checks remain separately required.

criteria.criterion: Actual production HTTP200/404 and correct resource/CTA endpoint responses verified against this output.
criteria.reason: Public-host pages, resources, genuine unknown-path 404 and external SKU HTTP have not been checked. Loopback evidence cannot earn these 10 required points.

criteria.criterion: Browser mobile/desktop readability, computed FAQ visibility and action usability verified.
criteria.reason: Coverage of 36 original PNG captures at 320, 390 and 1280 pixels, computed visibility and menu, skip-link and local navigation observations supports readability and bounded action usability. Fixed overlays, full Tab traversal and per-scroll hit testing remain limitations.

criteria.criterion: Keyword and H1 reflect same purchase task
criteria.reason: Title and H1 use the same exact primary query and buyer decision; the full primary query begins the title.

criteria.criterion: First answer gives photos/product range plus bounded consultation
criteria.reason: The complete first answer gives basic pricing and bounded consultation. It explicitly places the four photos on the Nammoon detail page, matching the home page with no product cards.

criteria.criterion: Cards add explanatory summary rather than title/first-answer duplication
criteria.reason: Home and support card summaries explain colors, basic versus total budget and order changes rather than duplicating the title, H1 or first answer.

criteria.criterion: No unverified operation/fulfillment or total-price promises
criteria.reason: No current-operation, entry, delivery-guarantee or final-total promise is made. Actual copy preserves conditional statements supported by originals.

criteria.criterion: One facility cluster on one detail URL
criteria.reason: One Nammoon facility cluster occupies one detail URL. Home is the regional entry and support provides noindex navigation.
